title: control.* payload
description: Control-plane commands. Subject = control.<command>. halt: stop everything, cancel all, no resume without operator. flatten: close all positions (implies pause_new). pause_new: no new entries; exits and stop management continue. resume: clears pause_new only, never a halt.

drill.description: True when issued by the weekly watchdog drill; consumers act exactly as if real, the flag exists only for the logs.
